units.source_text: 我断断续续地说了这许多。

en.t: I said all this in fits and starts.

units.source_text: 七段仍无动于衷，也不说声“下吧”。

en.t: The seventh-dan player remained unmoved and did not even say, "Go ahead and play."

units.source_text: 七段当然有正当的理由，他一再忍让，心里郁积着不服的情绪。

en.t: Of course, the seventh-dan player had proper reasons; he had yielded again and again, and resentment had built up in his heart.

units.source_text: 这次如又让步，那就得不顾自己的情况，明天就下了。

en.t: If he gave way again this time, he would have to disregard his own circumstances and play tomorrow.

units.source_text: 这样做实在不能充分发挥棋术，还是不下更符合自己的心意。

en.t: Playing under those conditions would truly keep him from fully displaying his skill, so not playing better suited his own wishes.
